leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the Ionic CLI to generate a new tab-based application shell.
Utilize Angular routing to define navigation paths for each tab.
Construct an Ionic tab bar component to serve as the primary navigation interface.
Implement tab-specific page components to display distinct content areas.
Define and assign routes within the main application routing module to connect tabs to their pages.
Use the Angular router-outlet directive to control the display of active tab content.
Execute the application in a browser to verify the tab navigation structure functions.
Modify the tab bar configuration to customize icons and labels for each navigation item.
Handle tab selection events to manage UI state and content updates.
Access and utilize Capacitor's native platform APIs to prepare the shell for mobile device deployment.
Store and retrieve navigation state to maintain the active tab across user sessions.
Compare the structure of a tab-based shell with other navigation patterns to reinforce architectural understanding.
